name: Yamiagari ni Muri wa Dame to Iu Koto
original_name: 病み上がりにムリはダメということ
source:
After recovering from food poisoning, Tenji Emperor decides to ignore doctor's instructions and arranges a great party with beer and meat. Emperor faces a big stomach trial.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
